welcome.title: First, choose where your games will live
welcome.lead: Each game becomes one folder. Start by telling this app where to keep them all. It only reads and writes inside the place you choose.
welcome.step1.title: Press the folder icon
welcome.step1.body: Use the folder icon at the left of the header to choose where you want your games kept.
welcome.step2.title: Grant access
welcome.step2.body: Your browser will ask for permission. Nothing outside the place you picked is ever touched.
welcome.step3.title: Create one with the file icon
welcome.step3.body: The file icon next to it creates a game. One folder appears and you can start editing right away.
welcome.note: Your browser remembers the place you chose, so the last game opens automatically next time.
